reason: A DeepSeek Harness runtime utility that applies pre-execution policies to dangerous shell, SQL, and file-write operations and redacts common credentials from post-execution output.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供危险工具操作的运行时策略控制，并对执行结果中的常见凭据进行脱敏。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness runtime utility that controls dangerous tool operations and redacts common credentials from execution results.

capabilities: Inspects tool names and arguments before execution
Denies or requests approval for configured dangerous operations
Redacts detected credentials from canonical results and rendered output
Loads a bundled read-only security-review skill
